articles.title: A 10-Minute X-Ray Flash May Mark the Birth of a Magnetar
articles.summary: An X-ray flash from a neutron star merger lasted nearly ten minutes, the longest of its kind observed. Researchers say the collision may have formed a magnetar, a neutron star with a huge magnetic field.

articles.title: Researchers Demonstrate a New Way to Identify the Quantum W State
articles.summary: Researchers at Kyoto and Hiroshima Universities developed and tested an entangled measurement that can identify the W state of three photons. It could contribute to quantum teleportation and computing.

articles.title: Two New Giant Stick Insect Species Found in Australia
articles.summary: Researchers identified two new large stick insect species in Australia, one with lidded eggs. A third, familiar species had been misidentified for decades. What was once counted as two species is really five.
